title: Training module: reach fills on a Prescriptions & Renewals controlled renewal
content:
**Prescriptions & Renewals training — how far a controlled renewal reaches.**

**The rule.** The reach fills are worked out by one of three methods: where the patient's latest-dated booked or confirmed visit with the prescribing department is 1 or more calendar days after the renewal date, they are the days to that visit divided by the per-fill days' supply, rounded up to a whole fill; where no such visit is booked or confirmed but the latest completed in-person visit with that department was fewer than 183 days before the renewal date, they are the days remaining until 183 days after that visit divided by the per-fill days' supply, rounded up; otherwise they are the class fills — the smaller of the class's refills per authorization plus one and the whole number of fills of the prescription's per-fill days' supply that fit in the class's total days' supply per authorization, rounded down.

**Questions answered.**

*Which visits are read?* The patient's In-Person Appointments with the department of the prescriber on this prescription. For the first method, the visit with the latest scheduled date among those recorded as booked or confirmed; for the second, the latest one recorded as completed.

*What does "rounded up to a whole fill" mean?* Any part of a fill counts as a whole fill: 1.1 fills becomes 2.

*What per-fill days' supply is used?* The per-fill days' supply recorded on the prescription on the renewal date.

*What if the latest booked visit is dated on or before the renewal date?* Then it is not 1 or more days after it, and the second method is examined.

**Worked cases (hypothetical).**

| Situation on the renewal date | Per-fill days' supply | Reach fills |
|---|---|---|
| confirmed visit 45 days later | 28 | 45 divided by 28 is about 1.61, so 2 |
| booked visit 90 days later | 30 | 3 |
| nothing booked; last completed in-person visit 100 days before | 30 | 83 divided by 30 is about 2.77, so 3 |
| nothing booked; last completed in-person visit 182 days before | 30 | 1 day remaining, so 1 |
| nothing booked; last completed in-person visit 183 days before | 30 | class fills |
| nothing booked; no completed in-person visit | 30 | class fills |
